gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G3: A refusal, a 404, a timeout or a no_contact is THIS RUNNER'S ACCESS AT THAT INSTANT and is never a statement about ICSID, about a proceeding, or about a document's existence. Binding on every row.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G5: Anything living in an HTML attribute or an href is invisible to this instrument, because the reducer strips tags before searching. A null under G5 licenses nothing.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G6: An undecoded HTML entity, or a U+200B or other zero-width character inside a literal, returns a clean find_matched:false INDISTINGUISHABLE from real absence. The hazard is proven live on this host, not theoretical (2026-08-23 records[8]).
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G7: A literal containing spaces is weaker than a space-free literal on this host, because inter-token markup can break it. `updated`, `Panama` are space-free; `Status of Proceeding` (2 spaces) and `Procedural Order No. 6` (3 spaces) are not, and their nulls are correspondingly weaker.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G9: FINAL-URL GATE. If final_url differs from url in any respect, the row is UNINTERPRETABLE as to the case designator: a redirect to a generic or different docket means the window describes some other page. Check final_url before reading any excerpt.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G10: A DOCUMENT DESIGNATION IS NOT THE TRIBUNAL'S CHARACTERISATION. A row that surfaces the title of a decision establishes that the title exists on that page and establishes nothing about what the decision held.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G13: A confirmation from a SINGLE page state is a confirmation from a single page state. Case name, designation, date and value contiguous in ONE window is the strong form; anything assembled ACROSS windows or page states is not.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G16: NO ROW IN THIS BATCH MAY FOUND AN ORDINAL, A COUNT, A DISPOSITION OR A HOLDING. The register-carried proceedings remain UNEXAMINED, not EXCLUDED. Any git-history count stated anywhere today must carry its anchor commit and its exclusions.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G17_new_today: WINDOW-EDGE GATE, promoted from near-miss 3 of the 2026-08-23 vetting note. The excerpt is a 400-character window whose left edge is placed at match_index - 100. A token lying within ~100 characters before the match is CUT, and a zero-hit screen on a string the evidence appears to contain is a window-edge question BEFORE it is an absence. No row may assert a page-scoped absence from a window-scoped null.
